summary: Tested new Google Reviews feature (unconfigured fallback path). Backend GET /api/reviews returns 200 with configured=false, reviews=[], correct shape. Root endpoint still works. Frontend Testimonials section renders 3 static fallback cards with 5 stars each, fallback note visible, google-rating-badge correctly hidden, no console errors, /api/reviews call succeeds (200).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER it's referenced in get_reviews() exception handler (logging.basicConfig at line ~195 while endpoint uses logger at line 170). If a Google fetch fails before module fully evaluates it could NameError; in practice at request-time it works because module is fully loaded. Still worth moving logger init above endpoint definitions.
server.py: React Testimonials fires /api/reviews twice on mount in dev (visible in network log) due to React 18 StrictMode double-effect — harmless but noted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works in unconfigured mode. If GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY/GOOGLE_PLACE_ID get populated later, retest configured=true path, cache TTL (12h), and google-rating-badge rendering.
